network_detail_select: Select a call to inspect phase evidence.
network_detail_legend: Timing confidence: exact / derived / inferred / approximated / partial / unknown. The minimized HAR adapter retains no phase timing or confidence evidence.
network_detail_not_exchange: This HAR entry does not establish a verified HTTP exchange, redirect chain or exchange count.
network_detail_outcome: Call outcome is unknown. HTTP status does not prove call success, failure or cancellation.
network_detail_phase_hint: Phase durations and their confidence were not retained. Missing phases are not zero-duration measurements.
network_detail_headers_excluded: Header names and values were irreversibly removed by aps-network-rust-minimized-v1; not an observed empty header set.
network_detail_body_excluded: Body content was irreversibly removed by aps-network-rust-minimized-v1; not an observed empty body.
network_detail_scope: Only published method, status, duration and byte counts are copied. URLs, hosts, timestamps, headers and bodies are not recoverable from this projection.
